lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical lines traversing the lateral torso. Spacing is roughly equidistant in the mid-section (approx. 5% of total torso width) and becomes more condensed at the posterior margin.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Ventral Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the 5th line from the posterior; dorsal Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the 8th line from the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1 and 2 are abbreviated dorsal segments. Line 4 is a truncated segment terminating mid-flank. Line 12 is a faint, partial segment at the anterior shoulder boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots on the lower haunch, density is highest immediately superior to the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior rump align in a diagonal trajectory (approx. 30 degrees) toward the base of the tail.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white patch on ventral throat; dark dorsal ridge line; white 'sock' markings on distal limbs; white chevron markings visible on muzzle profile.
